// config (generated from src/nodes; edit prompts and logic there or here)

const cfg = {
  llm_url: 'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',
  model: 'gpt-4o-mini',
  max_tokens: 1800,
  price_in_per_m: 0.15,   // USD per 1M input tokens (gpt-4o-mini)
  price_out_per_m: 0.60,  // USD per 1M output tokens (gpt-4o-mini)
  as_of_default: '2026-04-24',        // baseline "today" for the ABCDE sample data (decision D-02)
  project_start_default: '2026-03-30', // Monday of project week 1, inferred from task board due dates
  tracing_enabled: true,
  langfuse_host: 'https://cloud.langfuse.com',        // EU cloud. US cloud: https://us.cloud.langfuse.com
  data: {
    description: "AI Adoption Project Description for ABCDE Ltd.

ABCDE Ltd., a mid-sized enterprise specializing in logistics and supply chain solutions, is embarking on an AI adoption initiative to enhance operational efficiency, improve customer experience, and drive data-driven decision-making across the organization. This project will focus on integrating AI-powered tools into core business functions, including demand forecasting, route optimization, inventory management, and customer support. By leveraging machine learning models and natural language processing, the company aims to reduce manual overhead, minimize errors, and uncover actionable insights from historical and real-time data.

The AI adoption project will be implemented in phases, beginning with a detailed assessment of current workflows and data infrastructure, followed by pilot implementations in targeted departments. Key goals include reducing delivery delays by 15%, lowering operational costs by 10%, and improving service responsiveness. A cross-functional task force comprising data scientists, IT professionals, and business stakeholders will oversee the deployment and ensure alignment with organizational objectives. This strategic move is expected to position ABCDE Ltd. as a technology-forward leader in the logistics industry.",
    timeline_csv: "phase,phase_name,start_week,end_week,key_activities,milestones_deliverables
1,Project Initiation,1,2,"Define project scope; Form cross-functional team; Initial stakeholder meeting","Project charter signed off; Team structure finalized"
2,Current State Analysis,3,4,"Assess existing processes & systems; Identify data sources & gaps","Current systems audit report; Gap analysis report"
3,Use Case Selection,5,6,"Shortlist priority AI use cases (forecasting, route optimization)","Final list of prioritized use cases with success criteria"
4,Pilot Design,7,10,"Data collection & preparation; Model design and development","Working prototype models; Data pipelines established"
5,Pilot Implementation,11,14,"Deploy AI models in test environments; Monitor performance","Pilot results report; User feedback and performance metrics"
6,Evaluation & Iteration,15,16,"Evaluate pilot outcomes; Adjust models as needed","Updated models and process refinements"
7,Full Deployment,17,22,"Scale AI models across selected departments; Train staff","Full production rollout; Training sessions completed"
8,Monitoring & Review,23,24,"Continuous performance monitoring; Final project review","Project closure report; Recommendations for future scaling"
",
    risks_csv: "risk_id,category,risk_challenge,impact,mitigation_strategy
R01,Data Quality & Availability,Incomplete or unstructured data,Poor model performance and inaccurate outcomes,Perform early data audits and implement robust data governance
R02,Integration Issues,Difficulty integrating AI with legacy systems,Delays in deployment and operational disruptions,Plan integration roadmap and use APIs/middleware
R03,Talent & Skills Gap,Lack of internal AI/ML expertise,Overreliance on external vendors and slow progress,Provide staff training and hire specialized talent
R04,Change Resistance,Employees resist adopting AI-driven workflows,Low adoption and reduced ROI,Strong change management and early engagement
R05,Ethical & Legal Concerns,Risks of biased models or data privacy violations,Legal repercussions and reputational damage,Involve legal early and implement fairness checks
R06,Cost Overruns,Underestimation of AI development costs,Budget constraints and project delays,Set realistic budget and build in contingency funds
R07,Unrealistic Expectations,Stakeholders expect immediate ROI,Disillusionment and loss of support,Align expectations and show quick wins
R08,Model Performance Drift,AI models lose accuracy over time,Incorrect decisions and trust erosion,Regular retraining cycles and monitoring dashboards
R09,Security Vulnerabilities,AI models targeted by adversarial attacks,Data breaches and operational risks,Adopt AI security best practices and penetration testing
R10,Vendor Lock-in,Overdependence on a specific AI platform,Flexibility loss and future switching costs,Favor open standards and negotiate flexible vendor terms
",
    board_csv: "task_id,task_name,status,assignee,priority,sprint,due_date,labels,description
T001,Define project scope and objectives,Done,Arjun Mehta,High,Sprint 1,2026-04-07,Planning,"Document project scope, goals, and success criteria for AI adoption"

T006,Identify data gaps and quality issues,In Progress,Priya Nair,High,Sprint 2,2026-04-21,Analysis,"Gap analysis report comparing available data vs requirements for AI models"
T007,Shortlist AI use cases,In Progress,Arjun Mehta,High,Sprint 3,2026-04-28,Use Cases,"Evaluate and prioritize: demand forecasting, route optimization, inventory mgmt, customer support"
T008,Define success criteria for each use case,To Do,Sarah Lin,High,Sprint 3,2026-05-02,Use Cases,"Set measurable KPIs: 15% reduction in delivery delays, 10% cost reduction"
T009,Vendor evaluation for ML platform,To Do,James Wong,Medium,Sprint 3,2026-05-05,Use Cases,"Compare cloud ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, GCP Vertex AI)"

"
  }
};
return [{ json: Object.assign({}, it.json, { cfg: cfg }), binary: it.binary }];

parameters.content:
## Mira
Orchestrator routes each request to a specialist.

**Agents:** Orchestrator, Planner, Risk Assessor, Status Reporter (status report and stakeholder update), Milestone Tracker.

**Credentials to set:** OpenAI (node "LLM call (OpenAI)") and Langfuse basic auth (node "Langfuse trace": public key as user, secret key as password).

**Settings:** edit the node "Config" (model, prices, as-of date, Langfuse region).

### Grounding guardrails
Counts, tables, dates and health are computed by code. The model writes narrative only, and every task id, risk id, phase and milestone it returns is checked against the source files before output.
